[CREATURE:WRAITH_VILE_PLAGUE]
	[CREATURE_CLASS:ALL_CREATURES][DESCRIPTION:Held aloft by two expansive skeletal wings, the massive plague wraith towers over thirty feet tall. Under its tattered cloak, a black mass of writhing insects and serpents cling tightly to a nearly fleshless skeleton. Four elongated arms, covered in a tangle of scorpions and spiders, end in wickedly curved talons that twitch in anticipation of its next victim. Practically obscured by the inky shadows cast by its voluminous hood, two flaming emerald eyes partially illuminate its malevolent hook-toothed skull. In one massive hand it hefts a severely curved steel scythe with a twisted ironwood haft.]
